skill: parallel lines cut by a transversal
stem: Line l is parallel to line m, and line t intersects both. The angle below line l on the right side of the transversal measures 118 degrees; the angle above line m on the same side of the transversal (its same-side interior partner) measures x degrees. What is the value of x? Options: 28, 62, 118, 242.
figure: Two horizontal parallel lines l and m cut by transversal t; 118-degree angle marked at the upper intersection and x-degree angle marked at the lower intersection, both interior on the right of t.

stem: In triangle ABC, D lies on side AB and E lies on side AC, with segment DE parallel to segment BC. AD = 6, DB = 4, and DE = 9. What is the length of BC? Options: 6, 13, 15, 22.5. (Figure not drawn to scale.)

skill: equation of a circle in the xy-plane
stem: The graph of a circle in the xy-plane is shown; its center is at (3, -1) and it passes through the point (7, 2). Which equation defines the circle? Options: (x-3)^2+(y+1)^2=25; (x-3)^2+(y+1)^2=5; (x+3)^2+(y-1)^2=25; (x+3)^2+(y-1)^2=5.
figure: Coordinate grid with axes; circle of radius 5 with center dot labeled (3, -1) and a marked point on the circle labeled (7, 2).
